newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NGC Corp raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NGC Corp raised to buy.

text.p: -- Jefferies & Co Inc said it raised its rating on shares of NGC Corp to buy from hold based on a positive reassessment of the company's outlook after it disclosed first quarter charges in its natural gas liquids wholesale business.

-- In a statement, Jefferies said its review points to several developments that should prevent similar charges in the future. It notes the adoption of improved operational and accounting procedures, structural changes which will improve informational access and operating control, and restructuring of some personnel. Also, the chief financial officer position is expected to be filled shortly, Jefferies said.
